conventions: Positions are relative to the house SE outside corner (E = feet east of the east wall face, N = feet north of the south wall face) unless stated; bearing = compass direction the camera looks, in house-axis degrees (0 = house 'north' along the long axis, 90 = east). Heights above grade. FOV = full horizontal FOV across the full print width of the listed scan (prints are trimmed; lens unknown, probably a ~6-8 in lens on a 4x5 or 5x7 plate).
solve_method: 1-D projective fit of window/door positions along the east wall (from the blueprint) to their image x-coordinates, combined with apparent window heights (h ~ 1/depth); see derivation fields. Treat as starting values and refine by matching the log courses and window edges in Blender (fSpy or manual).
